reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) supports that fine grains increase surface strength and improve wear resistance in a CoCrFeMnNi HEA, but it does not address CoCrFeNi, oxide glaze formation, or high-temperature stability up to 800 °C, leaving several key premises unsupported.
premises: Grain refinement increases surface strength of CoCrFeNi HEA
Higher surface strength from fine grains improves wear resistance
Fine grains promote formation of a protective oxide glaze layer
The oxide glaze layer reduces friction and wear at high temperatures
Ultrafine grains remain stable up to 800 °C with nano-precipitate assistance
